title: 〜の中で〜がいちばん・どちらも／どれも

points.gloss: the most … of all (three or more)

connect.pos: 〜 is the group (a noun), then the one that is the most
connect.rule: 〜{の[中|なか]で}〜が{いちばん}〜です

connect.pos: Asking: 何 for a thing, どこ for a place, だれ for a person
connect.rule: 〜{の[中|なか]で}[何|なに]／どこ／だれが{いちばん}〜ですか

connect.pos: Three or more things named one by one: ask with どれ
connect.rule: 〜と〜と〜{の[中|なか]で}、どれが{いちばん}〜ですか

examples.ja: くだもの{の[中|なか]で}りんごが{いちばん}すきです。
examples.en: Of all fruits, I like apples best.

examples.ja: [行|い]ったところ{の[中|なか]で}、どこが{いちばん}よかったですか。
examples.en: Of the places you went to, which one was the best?

watch.note: いちばん picks one out of three or more. With only two things, ask with どちら.
watch.bad: りんごとみかんの中で、どれがいちばんすきですか。
watch.good: りんごとみかんと、どちらがすきですか。

connect.pos: Two things: both (with a negative ending: neither)
connect.rule: {どちらも}〜です・{どちらも}〜じゃありません

connect.pos: Three or more: things, people, places
The ending can be positive or negative; だれも almost always takes a negative
connect.rule: {どれも}おいしいです・{だれも}いません

examples.ja: この[二|ふた]つのケーキは{どちらも}おいしいです。
examples.en: Both of these two cakes are delicious.

examples.ja: へやには{だれも}いません。
examples.en: There is nobody in the room.

watch.note: だれも with a positive verb is not said for "everyone". Use みんな for that: みんな来ます.
watch.bad: あしたのパーティーには、だれも来ます。
watch.good: あしたのパーティーには、みんな来ます。

compare.intro: All three compare things. いちばん picks one out of three or more, のほうが picks one out of two, and どれも says the same thing about all of them.

forms.tag: いちばん · the most (three or more)
forms.ja: この[三|みっ]つの[中|なか]で、これが{いちばん}[安|やす]いです。
forms.en: Of these three, this one is the cheapest.

forms.ja: これ{のほうが}それより[安|やす]いです。
forms.en: This one is cheaper than that one.

forms.ja: この[三|みっ]つは{どれも}[安|やす]いです。
forms.en: All three of these are cheap.

check.label: くだものの話
check.q: A：りんごとみかんと、どちらがすきですか。B：（　　）すきです。
why: いちばん needs three or more things, and B does not say which one. いちばんすきです does not answer A's question.
A asks about two fruits, and B likes both: どちらもすきです.
どれも is for three or more. With two things, use どちらも.

drill.label: Choose the form
drill.q: くだものの（　　）、^[何|なに]がいちばん^すきですか。
why: With いちばん, the group you choose from is marked with の中で. の中に is for where something is, like かばんの中にあります.
の中で gives the group: of all fruits, which one do you like best?
が is already on 何, the one being picked. くだものの中が does not fit here.
を marks what a verb acts on. There is no verb here that takes 中を.

drill.label: Choose the form
drill.q: A：かぞくの[中|なか]で、（　　）がいちばんせが[高|たか]いですか。B：^[父|ちち]です^。
why: どこ asks about a place, but B answers with a person.
何 asks about a thing. For people in the family, ask with だれ.
The answer is a person (父), so the question word is だれ: who is the tallest?
いつ asks about a time, but B answers with a person.

drill.label: Choose the form
drill.q: ^この[二|ふた]つのかさは^（　　）[高|たか]いです。
why: 二つ means two umbrellas, so "both" is どちらも.
どれも is for three or more things. Here there are only two.
だれも is for people, and umbrellas are not people.
どこも is for places, and umbrellas are not places.

drill.label: Choose the form
drill.q: A：この[店|みせ]の^パン^はどうですか。B：（　　）おいしいですよ。
why: だれも is for people, and bread is not a person.
何も goes with a negative ending, like 何もありません. 何もおいしいです is not said.
どこも is for places. B is talking about the bread, not about places.
The shop has many kinds of bread, and どれも with a positive ending means every one of them is good.

drill.label: Build the sentence
drill.before: この[三|みっ]つのかばんの
drill.hint: First finish the group with の中で. Then the question word, then what you want to know.
drill.full: この[三|みっ]つのかばんの[中|なか]でどれが{いちばん}[安|やす]いですか。
drill.explain: かばんの needs 中で right after it to make the group. どれが is the one being picked, then いちばん安い, and ですか ends the question.

drill.label: Build the sentence
drill.before: [本|ほん]を[三|さん]さつ[読|よ]みましたが、
drill.hint: Which word means "every one of the three books"? あまり needs a negative ending.
drill.full: [本|ほん]を[三|さん]さつ[読|よ]みましたが、{どれも}あまりおもしろくありませんでした。
drill.explain: どれも, every one of the three books, comes first. あまり goes before the negative おもしろくありませんでした, which ends the sentence.

exam.label: Choose the form
exam.q:
A「この　店の　ケーキの　中で　（　　）が　いちばん　人気が　ありますか。」
B「この　白い　ケーキです。」
exam.explain: A picks one cake out of the shop's cakes, so the question word is どれ. だれ is for people, どこ is for places and いつ is for times, but B answers with a cake.

exam.label: Choose the form
exam.q:
A「へやに　だれか　いますか。」
B「いいえ、（　　）　いません。」
exam.explain: いいえ … いません means there is nobody, and "nobody" is だれも with a negative ending. だれか is "someone" and does not fit after いいえ, だれが asks "who", and だれに does not go with いません here.

exam.label: Build the sentence
exam.after:
いちばん　新しい　本ですか。」
B「その　白い　本です。」
exam.full:
A「この　三つの　{中で}　どれが　いちばん　新しい　本ですか。」
B「その　白い　本です。」
exam.explain: この, 三つの, 中で, どれが. この goes before 三つの, the group ends with 中で, and どれが, the one being picked, comes right before いちばん.

scene.ja: デパートの人気ランキング
scene.en: A poster of this month's most popular items in a department store
scene.intro: Tap every word with kanji that you can find on the ranking poster.

check.label: How the exam asks it
check.q: この　店で　いちばん　_人気_が　ある　本は　どれですか。
check.explain: 人気 is read にんき, "popular". 人 is にん here, as in 三人, and 気 is き, as in 天気. にんぎ, ひんき and にき are not words.

skill.ask: Which season does Yuki like best, and why?
skill.passage:
マリアさんへ
わたしは　一年の　中で　あきが　いちばん　すきです。^天気が　よくて、山の　木が　とても　きれいだからです^。なつは　あついですから、あまり　すきじゃ　ありません。食べものの　中では　魚が　いちばん　すきです。父の　店の　魚は　どれも　おいしいですよ。
ユキ
skill.strategy: Find the sentence with いちばんすき about a season, then read the next sentence: the reason ends in からです.

item.q: ユキさんは　どうして　あきが　いちばん　すきですか。
options: 魚が　おいしいから
天気が　よくて、山の　木が　きれいだから
あきは　あついから
父の　店が　あるから
item.explain: Right after あきがいちばんすきです, Yuki writes the reason: 天気がよくて、山の木がとてもきれいだからです.
why: Fish is Yuki's favourite food, and the fish is good, but that is not why Yuki likes autumn.
It is summer that is hot (なつはあついですから), and that is why Yuki does not like summer.
Yuki's father has a shop with good fish, but this is about food, not about autumn.
